name: Design Kit
description: Design projects with a categorized component & hook library (shadcn-style live previews), one project per Design Kit App instance.

apps.title: Design Kit
apps.description: A design project: a categorized component & hook library with live previews, stored as the instance's own git repository. The instance's slug is the project's registry namespace, minted from its name at add time.

actions.label: List components
actions.description: List all components & hooks in this instance's project (summaries: name, title, type, category, description).

actions.label: Read component
actions.description: Read a component's META (title, type, category, description, exportName, dependencies, registryDependencies, signature). Does NOT return file contents — use readFiles. Pass listFiles: true to also get file paths.

listFiles.description: Also include the component's file paths (not content).

actions.label: Create / replace component
actions.description: Edits the component's DRAFT — publishComponent is what makes a change reach installers. Create a component, or FULLY REPLACE its META. Unspecified fields reset to defaults. Preview/props/sheets/examples live in files (docs/*) — use writeFiles/editFiles.

type.description: Whether this is a component or a hook.

exportName.description: The symbol the files export, used to render previews.

registryDependencies.description: Other registry items this depends on. "@design-kit/<name>" references a sibling in this project.

expectedState.description: The component's `state` as last read; given, the write is refused if the component changed since. Opaque — hand back what readComponent returned. Ignored when creating.

actions.label: Edit component
actions.description: Edits the component's DRAFT — publishComponent is what makes a change reach installers. Partial META update — only the fields you pass change. Does not rename — use moveComponent.

expectedState.description: The component's `state` as last read; given, the edit is refused if the component changed since. Opaque — hand back what readComponent returned.

actions.label: Publish component
actions.description: Publish a component's draft: the working copy becomes what installers and the registry are served, the version is incremented and the replaced record is filed in history. The publish is committed under the caller's name, as the host identifies the caller. Publishing with no unpublished changes reports { published: false }. The result carries lastValidation when the draft has been checked.

expectedVersion.description: The published version you are building on; given, the publish is refused if someone else published since.

actions.label: List revisions
actions.description: A component's publish history, newest first: version, publishedAt, and the files each version changed.

actions.label: Read a version
actions.description: A component's files as one published version shipped them. Null when that version is not held. Pass "draft" for the working tree, or "none" for the empty state before the component's first version.

version.description: A published version number, "draft" for the working tree, or "none" for the empty state before the first version.

actions.label: Compare two versions
actions.description: What differs between two points in a component's history, file by file: added, removed, changed or unchanged. Every file is listed; CONTENT is carried only where something changed (null means the file did not exist on that side, and an unchanged file carries no content at all — read one with readVersion). Each end is a version number, "draft", or "none" (the empty state before the first version). This compares the two ends given, literally. To ask instead what one version INTRODUCED, pass the version below it as the older end — the version below it in listRevisions, not its number minus one, and "none" only when listRevisions shows it as the earliest version this project holds AND that is v1. Where the earliest version held is above v1 the state below it does not exist here, and comparing against "none" would report every file as added at a version the component merely survives from.

from.description: The older end: a version number, "draft", or "none" for the empty state.

to.description: The newer end: a version number, "draft", or "none" for the empty state.

actions.label: Changes since
actions.description: Which components changed since a reference point, with their current version. Pass exactly ONE of: since (ISO 8601 or epoch ms), or sinceVersions (a map of componentId-or-name to the version you hold).

sinceVersions.description: Map of componentId or name to the version the caller holds.

actions.label: Delete component
actions.description: Remove a component from this project by name. Takes it out of the published registry as well as the draft, in one commit scoped to that component's own paths — deleting is not an authoring change awaiting a publish, and a published component stops being served immediately. Returns the commit that removed it, or null when it had never been published and there was nothing to remove.

actions.label: Move / rename component
actions.description: Rename a component (toName) and/or move it to another project (toProject). Does not rewrite file contents; use moveFiles to rename file paths.

toName.description: New slug (kebab-case). Omit to keep the name.

toProject.description: Destination project id or namespace. Omit to stay in this project.

actions.label: Get dependency graph
actions.description: The component's dependency graph, with provenance-tagged edges, reverse "used by" edges, and every reference that resolves to nothing listed under `unresolved`.

name.description: Component slug whose graph to build.

actions.label: Read theme
actions.description: Read the project's current preview theme: the saved preset/custom CSS, the effective shadcn style (shadcnStyle; new-york-v4 unless set with setShadcnStyle), plus the effective resolved CSS previews render with.

actions.label: Set theme
actions.description: Set the project's preview theme: a preset id and/or custom token CSS. Omitting css clears customization; omitting preset resets to the default. Returns the saved theme.

preset.description: One of the ids from listThemePresets. Omit to reset to the default preset.

css.description: Custom token CSS. Overrides the preset when set; omit/empty to clear.

actions.label: Set shadcn style
actions.description: Set the shadcn registry style this project's previews resolve `@/components/ui/*` against (e.g. base-vega for a kit built on Base UI primitives; default new-york-v4). Create-era styles (base-*, radix-vega, radix-nova) also compile shadcn's custom Tailwind variants (data-open:, data-horizontal:, ...) into the preview. Leaves preset/css untouched; setTheme likewise leaves the style untouched. Returns the saved theme.

style.description: One of the ids from listShadcnStyles. Omit/empty to reset to new-york-v4.

actions.label: List shadcn styles
actions.description: List the shadcn style ids setShadcnStyle accepts, marking the default.

actions.label: List theme presets
actions.description: List the built-in preset ids/labels available for setTheme's preset field.

actions.label: Read files
actions.description: Batch-read a component's files. Returns [{ path, target, type, content }]. Omit paths to get every file.

component.description: Component slug whose files to read.

paths.description: File paths/targets to read. Omit to read all files.

actions.label: Write files
actions.description: Edits the component's DRAFT — publishComponent is what makes a change reach installers. Batch upsert files (matched by path/target; added if new). Atomic. Returns a validation field unless validate is false.

expectedState.description: The component's `state` as last read; given, the write is refused if the component changed since. Opaque — hand back what readComponent returned.

validate.description: Validate the component's preview after writing (default true).

files.description: Files to upsert. Each: { path, target?, type?, content }.

actions.label: Edit files
actions.description: Edits the component's DRAFT — publishComponent is what makes a change reach installers. Batch string-replace across a component's files. ALL-OR-NOTHING. Returns a validation field on success unless validate is false.

expectedState.description: The component's `state` as last read; given, the edit is refused if the component changed since. Opaque — hand back what readComponent returned.

validate.description: Validate the component's preview after editing (default true).

edits.description: Edits. Each: { path, old, new, replaceAll? }.

actions.label: Move / rename files
actions.description: Edits the component's DRAFT — publishComponent is what makes a change reach installers. Batch-rename file paths within a component (atomic). Changes paths only, never content.

component.description: Component slug whose files to rename.

expectedState.description: The component's `state` as last read; given, the move is refused if the component changed since. Opaque — hand back what readComponent returned.

actions.label: Delete files
actions.description: Edits the component's DRAFT — publishComponent is what makes a change reach installers. Batch-delete a component's files by path/target. Returns { deleted, missing, removedFiles }: deleted and missing partition the strings you asked for, removedFiles names every file record actually removed — which is more than one when several records answer to the same string.

component.description: Component slug whose files to delete.

expectedState.description: The component's `state` as last read; given, the delete is refused if the component changed since. Opaque — hand back what readComponent returned.

actions.label: Glob files
actions.description: Find file paths by glob across the project, or within one component. Returns [{ component, path }].

component.description: Restrict to one component. Omit to search the whole project.

actions.label: Grep files
actions.description: Search file contents by regular expression across the project, or within one component. Returns [{ component, path, line, text }].

component.description: Restrict to one component. Omit to search the whole project.

actions.label: Validate component preview
actions.description: Server-side preview validation: evaluates the component's source and its preview pool, renders its doc targets. Omit name to validate every component (slow on a large project).

name.description: Component slug to validate. Omit to validate every component in the project.
